newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: LG Ind targets 2.0 trln won '97 sales.
newsitem.headline: LG Ind targets 2.0 trln won '97 sales.

text.p: South Korea's LG Industrial System Co Ltd, a maker of industrial and electrical systems, said on Thursday it forecast 1997 sales at two trillion won, compared with this year's target of 1.8 trillion won.
LG Industrial is a unit of the LG Group.
The company said in a statement that it would raise its facility investment to 150 billion won in 1997 from an estimated 110 billion spent this year.
It would also spend 110 billion won in research and development in 1997 against an estimated 80 billion in 1996.

LG Industrial forecast revenue from overseas business would be 300 billion won, 16 percent of total sales. It currently has 21 branches and subsidiaries overseas, and plans to expand its network to 26 next year.
